services.title: SaaS & web platforms
services.text: Complete products from the first wireframe to production: marketing site, app, API, database and admin back office, built to scale with your business.

services.title: Payments & billing
services.text: Stripe Checkout, wallets, subscriptions and per-minute billing, with verified webhooks, idempotency and reconciliation done right the first time.

services.title: Real-time features
services.text: Live chat, presence, notifications, voice and video calls for marketplaces, support desks and collaborative tools.

services.title: AI assistants & automation
services.text: AI chatbots that know your business, on your site and on WhatsApp, plus automations that remove repetitive admin work.

services.title: Cloud deployment & DevOps
services.text: Production-grade hosting you can rely on: Linux servers, Nginx, SSL, process management and push-to-deploy pipelines.

services.title: Legacy modernization
services.text: Taking over existing codebases: stabilise, secure and modernise them while they stay live, then keep shipping new features.

process.title: Discover
process.text: A short call to understand your goals, users and constraints. You get a clear scope, a timeline and a fixed or milestone-based quote.

process.title: Design
process.text: Architecture, data model and interface designed before the build, so there are no surprises later.

process.title: Build
process.text: Weekly, visible progress on a staging link. You see real software early and steer it as it takes shape.

process.title: Launch & run
process.text: Production deployment, monitoring and CI/CD. I stay on after launch for fixes, improvements and new features.

faq.q: Do you work alone or with a team?
faq.a: Alone. Every project in this portfolio was designed, built and deployed by me. You get one accountable engineer who knows the whole system, with no handoffs and no account managers.

faq.q: Can you take over an existing project?
faq.a: Yes. Tenant Certification is a good example: I took over a platform started by earlier teams, stabilised and modernised it while it stayed live, and I'm still its sole developer.
Usually a fixed price per milestone after a short discovery call, so you always know what you're paying for. Ongoing maintenance can be monthly or hourly.

faq.q: Which time zones do you work with?
faq.a: My clients are in the USA and Europe. I keep several overlapping hours each day for calls and stay reachable on WhatsApp and email.

faq.q: Do you handle hosting and deployment?
faq.a: Yes. I set up servers (AWS, DigitalOcean), Nginx, SSL, process management and automated deployments, and I can run them for you after launch.
